OneBill Software Inc\. announced on July 22, 2025, that it has officially integrated its cloud-based billing and monetization platform with Cisco BroadWorks\. The collaboration aims to streamline customer onboarding, billing accuracy, and revenue operations for service providers leveraging Cisco’s cloud communication platform\. The announcement was first reported through PR Newswire by OneBill Software\. This move is designed to fully automate service provisioning workflows—allowing faster customer activation, fewer manual interventions, and better scalability in operations\. According to OneBill, the integration enables synchronized control over enterprise data, user credentials, and service packages directly from OneBill’s centralized interface\. ## Why is this integration important for Cisco BroadWorks service providers? The newly launched integration focuses on creating a seamless, automated journey from customer acquisition to revenue realization\. # TOTVS Cancels 20 Million Shares, Launches New Buyback Markets: São Paulo Key Facts —**Decision\.** TOTVS’s board voted on 4 August 2026 to cancel 20 million treasury shares and to open a new buyback of up to 30 million shares\. —**Cancellation\.** The 20 million canceled shares equal 3\.34% of issued stock; the company will hold 579\.4 million ordinary shares, with no change to share capital\. —**New program\.** Buyback Program II 2026 runs from 6 August 2026 to 5 August 2027 and covers up to 30 million ordinary shares\. —**Backdrop\.** The canceled stock came from an earlier program that bought 20 million shares at an average R$32\.17 \(about US$6\.33\) each, roughly R$643 million \(about US$127 million\)\. —**Purpose\.** TOTVS says the steps aim to improve capital allocation and increase value for shareholders\. Brazilian software maker TOTVS has canceled 20 million treasury shares and approved a fresh share buyback of up to 30 million more, extending an aggressive campaign to return capital to shareholders\.
